name: R R Securities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, R R Securities Ltd is in the business of trading in shares, securities, and properties[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
RRSL is engaged in  providing Financial 
Services and Real Estate Rental Services 
including:
a) Long-term investment of funds
b) Rental Income from Fixed Assets
c) Profit and loss making from Real Estate Investment
d) Real estates

cons: Stock is trading at 2.86 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.73% over last 3 years.
